name: Now Playing Overlay
description: Native Now Playing and Party queue presentation for Kiosk Satellite and Fotoo, including a compact queue overlay and a dedicated full-screen Party Mode.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show overlay on
settings.description: Choose whether Now Playing is shown on Kiosk Satellite's own screensavers, Fotoo, or both.

settings.title: Visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant entity that controls whether this overlay is allowed to appear.

settings.title: Visibility condition
settings.description: Active recognizes on, true, home, playing, open, detected, occupied and present. Time between does not need an entity.

settings.title: Visibility value
settings.description: Value for the condition. Examples: on, 30, 10..200, or 22:00-06:00.

settings.title: Now Playing entity
settings.description: Choose the Home Assistant media_player entity to follow.

settings.title: Show while paused
settings.description: Keep the Now Playing card visible while playback is paused.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Vertical position of the Now Playing card.

settings.title: Edge offset
settings.description: Distance from the selected top or bottom edge.

settings.title: Width
settings.description: Width of the Now Playing card as a percentage of the screen.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the Now Playing card.

settings.title: Show progress bar
settings.description: Show playback position when duration and position are available.

settings.title: Time labels
settings.description: Choose time labels under the progress bar.

settings.title: Show next track
settings.description: Show the next track when available.

settings.title: Next track entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant sensor/text entity containing the next track title.

commands.title: Party Mode: open full screen in Kiosk
Party Mode: use standard Now Playing
